summary: Short links hide their destination, so the main risks are spoofing (users trust the shortener's domain) and information disclosure through URLs. The design mitigates the deceptive-destination techniques that can be detected without a network call.

threats.description: Attacker shortens a phishing URL so victims trust the shortener domain
threats.mitigation: Configurable domain blocklist with subdomain matching

threats.description: User info hides the real host: https://bank.example@evil.test
threats.mitigation: Reject any URL with user info

threats.description: Blocklist bypass with IP literals or numeric/hex host encodings
threats.mitigation: Treat IPv4, IPv6, decimal and hex hosts as IP literals and reject them

threats.description: Rejected URLs with credentials written to logs or error bodies
threats.mitigation: Error messages describe the rule only; rejected URLs are never logged

threats.description: Very large blocklist slows down link creation
threats.mitigation: Set-based suffix checks, linear in the number of host labels
